hypothesis: The effect of a skill depends on which facts it preserves or displaces. Transfer individual measured treatment differences by matching annotated evidence utterances in donor histories to visible utterances of a new source. A first action should anticipate the later policy through cross-fitted donor continuations. No target question, answer or annotated evidence is a policy input.
representation: Use frozen Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, speaker-anonymized individual turns including the speaker role and image caption when present, unit-normalized on a single capped GPU at encoder duty <=0.30. Align the donor's first and second sessions with the target's respective sessions. For each donor evidence utterance take maximum cosine to any visible target utterance in that session and average across visible evidence turns. At root use only first-session turns; donors linked only to the second session have constant similarity. Within each donor dialogue and evidence linkage stratum, softmax eight times these similarities. Preserve each stratum's empirical fraction of eligible donor questions and give each donor dialogue equal mass.
credit: Early donors are all 12 four-path windows / 91 questions in six training histories, sessions 5-8. At the terminal decision, regress the paired F1 difference for the realized earlier action plus its parser-rechecked rule-2 credit. At root compare the observed values of both first actions integrated over their predicted conditional continuation. Add the root rule-2 effects on common continuation mass only. To construct donor backups for held history H and donor D, train terminal predictions excluding BOTH H and D. Later-session content in donors is available only to this training backup. Use an additive native logit correction predicted effect / 0.05 clipped to +/-2. Keep raw F1 throughout.
expansion: After all 88 questions /12 donor windows in sessions 9-12 have randomized endpoints and verified controls, freeze an expanded model. At terminal, a randomized donor supplies a difference only for its observed prefix when the pivot is terminal. At root, a randomized root donor supplies 2*[pi(b|1)*(Y1b-.5)-pi(b|0)*(Y0b-.5)] plus 2*min(pi(b|1),pi(b|0))*verified_credit for randomized fixed suffix b. Inverse inclusion weight and the fixed 0.5 centering yield the correct continuation contrast in design expectation. Early paired/saturated and later randomized evidence are mixed within the declared observed strata. No session-13+ label enters training.
controls: Compare true credit, raw outcomes with the identical two-stage learner, an actor with blind uniform within-stratum matching, a control that rotates whole effect rows within each donor dialogue and evidence linkage stratum at each stage while leaving the keys fixed, and a fixed-equal-suffix backup at root with real evidence and the same terminal actor. Add native, full terminal PPO and a constant propensity offset matched per observed decision node without inspecting evaluation outcomes. Record four-path or randomized focal and joint HT F1 per question, selected skill trace references, and writer/reader tokens.
decision: Pilot results on early factorial and later (training) windows are diagnostics. Expanded primary panel consists of 40 chronological randomized windows / 378 questions starting in session 13+, across the six training histories. Require >=90% coverage, >=4 positive histories vs matched rate, >=.02 focal F1 improvement over native and terminal, positive versus raw, sham, blind and rate, positive joint HT over native, and positive focal gain vs native on strictly post-freeze windows. Predictions for an individual window must predate all of its physical path scores to count as prospective. Only then enter independent development. Both locked full-history tests remain required.
